statement: A reference-engineering BOM READINESS table, NOT a final BOM. It records, per module and per representative component, what is datasheet-backed today, what is assumed, and what is still open. Representative parts already present in results/operational_cost_catalog.json are reused verbatim (BMI270, MAX86141, TMP117, OPT3001-Q1, ADS1292R, ADS1299-4, AD5940); none are silently replaced. No component is presented as a frozen final selection.
power_accounting_note: Component active-power values below are direct or derived datasheet points under stated conditions. They are NOT summed into a system power number. See system_readiness.system_average_power.
mass_accounting_note: No component/package mass is asserted as system mass. Datasheet package dimensions are not mass. See system_readiness.system_mass.

system_average_power.reason: Component active-power points exist for several ICs, but duty cycle, shared MCU, radio, regulator efficiency, battery, and module scheduling are not frozen. Summing datasheet maxima would be a fabricated number and is prohibited.
what_is_known: Per-component active/reference points (BMI270, MAX86141, TMP117, OPT3001-Q1, ADS1292R)

system_mass.reason: No component package mass is asserted as system mass; PCB, battery, enclosure, electrodes/adhesives/straps, and wiring/connectors are all unselected.

final_bom.reason: All parts are representative component classes, not selected final devices; shared MCU/radio/battery/regulator identities are open.
